# scala-type-system-tck corpus (vendored)

This `corpus/` is a vendored copy of the type-system TCK corpus, authored upstream at:

**https://github.com/retronym/scala-type-system-tck**

Each entry is `source.scala` (a Scala preamble) + `tck.json` (named type-expression
queries, conformance/baseTypeSeq/termType/baseType queries) + `expected.json`
(goldens generated by the upstream `ScalacEngine`, i.e. the Scala compiler used as
the reference oracle).

`org.jetbrains.plugins.scala.lang.typeSystemTck.TypeSystemTckTest` runs this corpus
against the IntelliJ PSI type system and compares against the goldens.

## Refreshing

Do **not** hand-edit the goldens. To update:

1. In a checkout of the upstream repo, edit/add corpus entries and run
   `scala-cli run reference -- generate` (regenerates `expected.json` from scalac).
2. Copy its `corpus/` over this directory.

Or point the test at a live checkout without copying via
`-Dscala.tck.corpus=/path/to/scala-type-system-tck/corpus` (or the
`SCALA_TCK_CORPUS` env var).
